contract: One function per operator named in the task parameters (see README): each takes the operator's input tensors (float32, CPU) and returns the result tensor. Score: geometric mean over the operators of reference time / candidate time (best of 3 timed runs after a warm-up), higher is better; every output must match the PyTorch reference within the operator's tolerance.
notes: NKIBench kernel recreated on the CPU with the benchmark's shapes; AWS Trainium and the NKI compiler are not involved.

CPU recreation of a GPU kernel task: the operator, shapes and correctness contract are kept; CUDA/Triton/NKI and the accelerator are replaced by float32 PyTorch on the CPU. The seed implements each operator with the plain PyTorch composition (speedup 1.0 by construction); speedups are comparable within the suite only.
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
